title.narrative: Strengthening the capacity of Caritas Makeni and Caritas Kenema for effective delivery of services

description.narrative: CAFOD has been working in partnership with the Caritas family in sierra particularly, the Caritas Kenema (CK) and Caritas Makeni (CM) since 1992. A number of projects aimed at community development, livelihoods and disaster risk reduction have been implemented during the course of the partnership. However there have been issues related to the capacity of the caritas family in Sierra Leone as a whole. Challenges have been in the areas of organisation governance, programmes implementation particularly monitoring and evaluation and financial management. In as much as CAFOD has the accompaniment approach that is aimed at building the capacity of partners they work with, this has not been very effective and is rather supply driven rather than demand driven. In 2012, the CAFOD organisational assessment of Caritas Kenema and Caritas Makeni offices, the DRR midterm evaluation report and the CAFOD audit report came up with a series of issues relating to the capacity of both organizations.
